ingress_default_deny_enforced.title: Ingress Default-Deny Enforced
ingress_default_deny_enforced.description: Default-deny inbound with finite (proto, port, destination) allow-list cross-referenced to asset inventory. No any/any/allow; no shadow public IP.

waf_active_blocking_on_public_web.title: WAF in Active Blocking Mode
waf_active_blocking_on_public_web.description: WAF in BLOCKING mode in front of every public HTTP app (OWASP CRS / equivalent), not monitor-only.

remote_access_via_ztna_or_mfa_vpn.title: Remote Access via ZTNA or MFA-Protected VPN
remote_access_via_ztna_or_mfa_vpn.description: Remote access via ZTNA or VPN with phishing-resistant MFA AND tunnel exits into segmented zone with per-app authz (not flat LAN).

edge_appliance_patched_within_sla.title: Edge Appliances Patched Within SLA
edge_appliance_patched_within_sla.description: Every internet-facing edge appliance on vendor-supported non-EOL firmware; no KEV-listed CVE past CISA BOD 22-01 deadline (15d internet-facing).

edge_management_interfaces_not_internet_.title: Edge Management Interfaces Not Internet-Reachable
edge_management_interfaces_not_internet_.description: Admin/mgmt planes of edge appliances bind to internal mgmt VLAN only; not reachable from public internet. Admin via bastion/ZTNA.

ddos_protection_in_place.title: DDoS Protection In Place
ddos_protection_in_place.description: Upstream volumetric (L3/L4) + L7 DDoS protection covers every public entry point (CDN/Shield/Cloudflare/Akamai) with engagement runbook.

egress_default_deny_enforced.title: Egress Default-Deny Enforced
egress_default_deny_enforced.description: Outbound default-deny with FQDN allowlist; client-side DoH to public resolvers blocked so corp DNS inspection cannot be bypassed.

dns_hardened.title: DNS Hardened
dns_hardened.description: Authoritative DNS: DNSSEC+DS at parent, no dangling CNAMEs (continuous takeover monitoring), DMARC p=reject + SPF -all + DKIM, registrar MFA+lock.

cloud_objects_not_anonymously_public.title: Cloud Object Storage Not Anonymously Public
cloud_objects_not_anonymously_public.description: No bucket (S3/Blob/GCS) holding non-public data permits anonymous read/write; account-level public-access-block enforced.

perimeter_crossings_logged_and_centraliz.title: Perimeter Crossings Logged and Centralized
perimeter_crossings_logged_and_centraliz.description: Every perimeter ingress/egress (firewall flow logs, VPN, WAF, VPC flow logs) shipped to central tamper-resistant store separate from audited devices; >=90d online.
